description: Move one queued or scheduled task later; it never runs earlier than planned. Use when: the user says "tonight" or "after my limit resets"; pass exactly one of preset, until or delay_minutes. Do not use to set a new due time (use update_deadline) or to stop it (use cancel_task). Behavior: rewrites this task's earliest start in the local queue and re-picks the cleanest hour after it, but an until time is kept exactly; after_limit_reset reads the Claude limits. Returns: status, not_before, scheduled_for, deadline. Rejects a target at or before the planned start, finished and unknown tasks.

delay_minutes.description: Minutes to add to the planned start, e.g. 90 for "an hour and a half later"; at most 10080 (7 days). Omit when passing preset or until.

preset.description: A named later time, in this machine's local time: '1h' is one hour after the planned start; 'tonight' is 22:00 to 06:00 (after midnight: now to 06:00); 'tomorrow_morning' is 09:00 to 12:00 tomorrow; 'after_limit_reset' is 5 minutes after the Claude limit reset (needs reset_at, this machine's limit reading or a reset time given before). Omit when passing until or delay_minutes.

reset_at.description: When the Claude limit resets, ISO-8601 with offset, if the user says it ("my limit resets at 15:00"). Only with preset 'after_limit_reset'; must be in the future and is remembered for later tasks. Omit to use this machine's limit reading.

task_id.description: Id of the queued or scheduled task to move later, e.g. 't-3f2a…', from the schedule_task reply or the check_queue_status list.

until.description: The exact time the user picked, ISO-8601 with offset, after the planned start, e.g. '2026-05-12T21:30:00+02:00'. Omit when passing preset or delay_minutes.

name: postpone_task
